name: Mihagino Konoka
source: [url=/c10367]Ayano's[/url] sister who is 3 years younger than her. Mischievous, energetic and a cheerful girl who likes her sister very much. Because she's interested in [url=/c10457]Haruto[/url], she moves in with him and Ayano. She loves to teasing Ayano and making her jealous.
